name: VALORANT
antiCheat: Riot Vanguard (kernel). This app never touches game files, the anti-cheat or the game process.
bound: Usually CPU-bound at high frame rates.
recommendations: Run in Fullscreen and enable NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency (On or On + Boost) — the in-game option is the lowest-latency choice.
Cap FPS a few frames below a level your PC sustains (use the in-game limiter) for stable frame times; with VRR cap ~3 FPS below refresh.
Material/texture quality matter less for FPS than 'Improve Clarity', 'Bloom' and 'Distortion' — disable these first on weak GPUs.
Close browsers and launchers: VALORANT's frame time is sensitive to background CPU load.
highEndSettings: Limit FPS: refresh rate or slightly above for consistent pacing

name: Fortnite
antiCheat: Easy Anti-Cheat / BattlEye. No game files or processes are modified.
bound: Performance mode is CPU-friendly; DX12 with Nanite/Lumen is heavily GPU-bound.
recommendations: Low-end PCs: use Rendering Mode 'Performance – Lower Graphical Fidelity'; it greatly reduces CPU/GPU load.
DX12 compiles shaders during the first matches — expect stutter that disappears afterwards (don't clear the shader cache unnecessarily).
Enable NVIDIA Reflex / AMD Anti-Lag in the game for lower latency.
Use the in-game frame-rate limit slightly below what you can sustain.
highEndSettings: Nanite/Lumen only if FPS stays above the refresh rate

name: Counter-Strike 2
antiCheat: Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC). No game files are modified.
bound: Mostly CPU-bound; benefits from fast single-thread performance and memory.
recommendations: Use 'Fullscreen' mode and enable NVIDIA Reflex in Video settings.
Boost Player Contrast: Enabled; Shader/particle detail: Low improves frame times on weak GPUs.
CS2 1% lows are very sensitive to background CPU load and RAM speed (enable XMP/EXPO in firmware — not changed by this app).
Use fps_max to cap slightly above your refresh rate or ~3 FPS below it with VRR.
highEndSettings: Multisampling AA instead of CMAA2 for clarity

name: Apex Legends
antiCheat: Easy Anti-Cheat. No game files are modified.
bound: Mixed; often CPU-bound at high refresh rates.
recommendations: Enable NVIDIA Reflex in Video settings.
Use the game's FPS cap (fps_max launch option) slightly below your sustained FPS for consistent frame times.
Texture streaming budget should fit within VRAM to avoid stutter.
highEndSettings: Texture streaming budget: High if VRAM allows

name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
antiCheat: BattlEye / Wellbia. No game files are modified.
bound: CPU-bound in late-game circles; GPU-bound at high resolutions.
recommendations: View distance has a strong CPU impact; textures mainly need VRAM.
Enable NVIDIA Reflex if available in your version.
Keep at least 16 GB RAM free of background apps for consistent frame times.

name: Call of Duty
antiCheat: RICOCHET (kernel). No game files or processes are modified.
bound: GPU-bound at high settings; CPU-bound in large modes at high refresh rates.
recommendations: First launch compiles shaders — let it finish before benchmarking.
Keep VRAM usage target ≤90% in the game's settings to avoid stutter.
Enable NVIDIA Reflex or AMD Anti-Lag.
Use DLSS/FSR/XeSS in Quality mode on GPU-bound systems.

name: Minecraft: Java Edition
recommendations: Allocate 4–8 GB to the game in the launcher; more is not better and can increase GC pauses.
Sodium (Fabric) dramatically improves FPS and frame times; install mods only from trusted sources.
Render distance is the biggest performance setting.
Set the GPU preference for javaw.exe to High performance on laptops with hybrid graphics.

name: Minecraft (Bedrock / Windows)
recommendations: Use Settings › Video › Render distance as the main performance setting.
Disable 'Fancy graphics' and 'Beautiful skies' on low-end GPUs.
Enable V-Sync off + in-game frame cap for lower latency.
highEndSettings: Ray tracing only on RTX GPUs with DLSS
